scope: Immutable plain/EDNS requests through owned TCP query, reset recovery and ordered server failover.

servers.scope:
Ordered TCP server failover with real loopback endpoints.

One server pass with one same-server length-read reset recovery per server.
DNS replies are returned without UDP response-code failover. Checks
closed attempts, final error selection, shared deadline and terminal abort.

legacy_query.scope:
Dedicated DNS TCP query with a deadline spanning setup and response handling.

Local Linux IPv4/IPv6 integration; no resolver policy or upstream suite claim.

limitations: Resolver search/alias/configuration request construction still uses plain-query wrappers.
No EDNS negotiation or fallback policy is introduced.
No compiler/cache experiment used and no compiler/runtime patch installed.
